title: Spending actions with the unchanged bot as an action, value iteration on r15
question: If the unchanged bot is one of the actions (bot, economy, army, research), does value iteration on r15 find turns where a spending boost pays, or does it learn to leave the bot alone?
change: Experiment 25 (state with the turn) with the action set spend4 = bot, economy, army, research instead of spend3; the bot is also the default for states without an entry.
method: 300k games with a random spend4 action per turn; value iteration with the turn and min-count 1, 5, 20, 50, 200; min-count chosen on 2,000 validation seeds; the chosen policy on the 10,000 evaluation seeds against r15 and against experiment 25's policy
setups: Perfection, 16×16 continents, 4 players, Crazy, seat 0 Xin-Xi (human seat), learner base greedy-full-probe-perf-r15; opponents greedy-full-probe-perf-r15, greedy-full-probe-perf, greedy-full-probe-perf (anchor), seats shuffled per seed (rl-gate defaults from 27 Nov)
